question: Which Indian athlete won the first-ever Paralympic gold in archery at the Paris 2024 Paralympics?
solution:
The correct answer is Harvinder Singh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Harvinder Singh **won India’s first-ever Paralympic gold medal in archery at the Paris 2024 Paralympics. 

 Testbook

 Testbook

 Competing in the Men's Individual Recurve Open category on 4 September 2024, Singh defeated Poland's Lukasz Ciszek with a dominant 6-0 score in the final at the Esplanade des Invalides. This victory marked the first gold medal in archery for India across both the Paralympic and Olympic Games
 
• **Sheetal Devi** became the first Indian athlete to win a **Paralympic gold medal in archery** at the **Paris 2024 Paralympics**.
 
• She achieved this historic feat in the **Women’s Compound Archery category**, showcasing exceptional skills and focus under pressure.
 
• Sheetal Devi is an inspiration in the **field of para sports**, especially as a **bilateral upper-limb amputee**, demonstrating immense perseverance and determination.
 
• Her win marked a significant milestone for India in the Paralympic Games, bringing pride and recognition to para-athletes across the country.
 
• The event highlighted India's growing dominance in international **archery competitions**, encouraging more individuals to pursue sports inclusively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sheetal Devi:**

 
 
• She hails from **Jammu and Kashmir** and has been a trailblazer in the realm of para archery.
 
• Despite her physical challenges as a bilateral upper-limb amputee, she uses a special **assistive device** to shoot arrows with precision.
 
• Her rigorous training and determination have made her a role model for aspiring para-athletes.
 
 
 
• **Paris 2024 Paralympics:**
 
 
• The Paralympic Games in **Paris, France**, showcased the talents of athletes with disabilities from around the globe.
 
• India’s performance at the event was remarkable, with athletes like Sheetal Devi achieving historic milestones.
 
 
 
• **Para Archery:**
 
 
• It is an inclusive sport that allows athletes with physical impairments to compete at national and international levels.
 
• Competitions are divided into categories based on the type and extent of disability, ensuring fair play.
 
• India has seen significant growth in this discipline, with increasing participation and support for para-athletes.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Paralympians:**
 
 
• **Harvinder Singh:** He was the first Indian to win a Paralympic medal in archery, securing a bronze at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
 
• **Rakesh Kumar:** A prominent Indian para-archer who has represented the country in multiple international events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **India’s Paralympic Achievements:**

 
 
• India has consistently improved its performance in the **Paralympic Games**, with increasing medals in disciplines like athletics, shooting, and archery.
 
• Government initiatives, such as the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**, have played a crucial role in supporting para-athletes.
 
 
 
• **Archery in India:**
 
 
• The **Archery Association of India (AAI)** is the governing body for the sport in the country.
 
• India has a rich tradition of excellence in archery, with athletes excelling in both able-bodied and para categories.
 
• Recent successes have increased awareness and investment in the sport at grassroots levels.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

**Sheetal Devi** is not the correct answer for this specific question because of the distinction between winning a medal and winning the **first-ever gold**.

Sheetal Devi won a **Bronze medal** (Mixed Team Compound) at the Paris 2024 Paralympics. Harvinder Singh is the correct answer because he won the Gold medal (Men's Individual Recurve), marking India's first-ever gold in the sport.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Harvinder Singh**".
